label: H.R. 2860
title: Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2025

items.snippet: This bill revises and reauthorizes for seven years the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative and its Northwest Straits Advisory Commission.
